executiveSummary: During the October 2026 monthly monitoring cycle, we reviewed App and Dashboard server performance, conducted build cache maintenance on both environments, and audited operational metrics across the past 30 days. Both servers remained stable with zero application errors observed. In addition, we conducted comprehensive storefront testing for the Integrity Reforestation Tree Contribution Widget on Craft (v16.1.0) and Beyond (Paid Theme Trial) across all device viewports, and performed end-to-end read-only regression testing on the Custom Admin Dashboard.

themeUpdateLog.summary: Shopify released maintenance updates for its modern theme collection. We audited Craft (v16.1.0), which is currently active on this store.
themeUpdateLog.testedNote: Craft (v16.1.0) is actively published on this store. Full Tree Contribution Widget compatibility, dynamic cart math, and multi-device responsive testing were executed — visual evidence and results on the following pages.

app.label: App Server
assessment: Response time recorded at 9 ms (vs. 7 ms in September), ensuring fast widget responsiveness.
Throughput remained below 1 RPS, consistent with steady production baseline traffic.
Memory utilization held steady at a lean 17% (identical to September: 17%).
Zero application errors or resource bottlenecks were recorded across the monitoring period.

dashboard.label: Dashboard Server
assessment: Recorded response time was 1,000 ms (1s) vs. 127 ms in September; flagged for continued tracking.
Throughput remained below 1 RPS, reflecting current administrative traffic volume.
Memory utilization improved from 20% in September to 15% this cycle.
Zero application errors, 5xx server exceptions, or crashes were observed.

performanceMetrics.conclusion: Both App and Dashboard environments maintained low memory utilization (<17%) and throughput under 1 RPS. While App response time remains exceptionally fast (9 ms), Dashboard response time (1s) will continue to be monitored in future cycles.

buildCacheAnalysis.conclusion: Build cache maintenance was successfully completed for both environments with no operational issues observed.

last24HoursUsage.title: Last 30 Days Usage & Stability
findings: Comprehensive 30-day review confirmed steady, error-free operational behavior across both dynos.
App server maintained an average 9 ms response time; Dashboard averaged 1,000 ms across the 30-day span.
Traffic throughput consistently tracked below 1 RPS with no unexpected traffic surges.
Memory usage remained healthy and contained at 17% (App) and 15% (Dashboard).
100% operational uptime maintained with zero application crashes or downtime reported.
last24HoursUsage.conclusion: The 30-day monitoring review demonstrated stable resource efficiency and zero downtime across both environments. Ongoing monitoring will track Dashboard response times.
